title: THE 74. SERMON OF IOHN CALVIN On Wednesday the xviij of September. 1555. The Lxxiiii. Sermon, in which the last verse of the tenth Chapter is expounded, and this is the first Sermon vpon the eleuenth

segments.text: 22 Thy fathers went downe into Egypt, in number threescore and ten soules: and now the Lord thy God hath made thee in multitude as the stars of the skie.
